feeds.title: The Exciting Centennial of Philippine Aviation
feeds.description: Welcome to our blog. Get to know the latest news with The Exciting Centennial of Philippine Aviation. We are trying to chronicle the relevant events from orbital satellites to human powered flights and all in between as we possibly could. We are also trying desperately hard to be accurate and factual as far as possible.

feeds.title: Laminar Aviation
feeds.description: Know more about Laminar through our news, blogs, testimonials, and case studies. The humble beginnings of our flying school started in 2005 by our Founder at the age of 23, who founded Laminar on the philosophy which focuses on standardized, quality & safe flight instructions from start to finish.

feeds.title: AAG Philippines Blog
feeds.description: Discover AAG blog articles to learn more about aviation, and have a lot of information in every corner of pilot training world. Our mission is to train and develop world-class pilots and future leaders for the aviation industry by providing top-of-the-class training solutions.

feeds.title: AvGeek Philippines
feeds.description: AvGeekPH.com is the Official Source of Everything AvGeek in the Philippines, including aviation news, flight schedules, airport news and more. Short for an 'Aviation Geek', the term AvGeek is commonly used in describing people who are amazed about airplanes/aircraft, airlines, and other aviation-related stuff.

feeds.title: Mond Ortiz
feeds.description: All about aviation, planes, airlines, and flight attendants. Get flight reviews, airline news, aviation facts, information on flying, tips, and advice on how to become a flight attendant. Mond Ortiz is an aviation enthusiast in the Philippines with a deep passion for airplanes.

feeds.title: Philippine Flight Network
feeds.description: Philippine Flight Network is the leading source of airline and aviation news in the Philippines. Explore our website to discover Philippine travel destinations, hotel reviews, attractions, airline news, restaurant experiences and much more!

feeds.title: Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines
feeds.description: Keep up with the latest announcements and press releases from the Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines. Our mission is to ensure a safe, secure, and green Philippine sky. We aim to be a pre-eminent Civil Aviation Authority in the world and a global brand of excellence in civil aviation.

feeds.title: Aviation Updates Philippines
feeds.description: Never miss a story. Get the latest Philippine aviation news and updates on our website. Aviation Updates Philippines is the leading aviation-dedicated news blog in the Philippines. We bring you the latest stories and news snippets as it happens.

feeds.title: INAEC
feeds.description: INAEC shares their aviation news and informs us about the latest updates in the company and other aviation related details. INAEC proudly traces its roots back in 1932 when it started as Iloilo-Negros Air Express Company, the first airline in the Philippines. It has evolved into a multi-mission aviation company offering an even wider range of aviation services.
